title: Kheria Autocomp IPO Details
intro:
Kheria Autocomp IPO is a book build issue of ₹46.44 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 45.98 lakh shares of ₹46.44 crore.

Kheria Autocomp IPO opens for subscription on Sep 17, 2026 and closes on Sep 21, 2026. The allotment for the Kheria Autocomp IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 22, 2026. Kheria Autocomp IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 24, 2026.

Kheria Autocomp IPO is set issue price band at ₹96 to ₹101 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,42,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,63,600.

SMC Capitals Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is SMC Global Securities Ltd.

Refer to Kheria Autocomp IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2009, Kheria Autocomp Ltd. is an auto ancillary unit engaged in the business of plastic injection moulding, specializing in the manufacture and sub-assembly operations of plastic components, primarily for the automotive sector.

The Company operates as a Tier-II supplier, producing moulded plastic components as per specifications for Tier-I vendors who supply to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) in the passenger vehicle categories.

Its product range is supplied for both internal combustion engine and electric vehicles (EVs), including interior cabin trims, exterior plastic parts, under-hood components, and heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) ducts. This positioning allows the Company to cater to the growing demand for sustainable and future-oriented mobility solutions within the EV ecosystem.

The Company’s manufacturing facility is located within the Tata Vendor Park at Sanand, Gujarat, covering an area of approximately 3 acres. The facility is equipped with 30 injection moulding machines with capacities ranging from 120 tons to 1,700 tons. The Company also demonstrates a commitment to sustainability, having installed a 636 kW solar power system and four groundwater recharge wells at its site.
As of March 31, 2026, the Company had a team of approximately 113 employees.

The Company’s manufacturing facility is located within the Tata Vendor Park at Sanand, Gujarat, covering an area of approximately 3 acres. The facility is equipped with 30 injection moulding machines with capacities ranging from 120 tons to 1,700 tons. The Company also demonstrates a commitment to sustainability, having installed a 636 kW solar power system and four groundwater recharge wells at its site.

faqs.question: How to apply in Kheria Autocomp IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Kheria Autocomp IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Kheria Autocomp IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Kheria Autocomp IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Kheria Autocomp IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Kheria Autocomp IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Kheria Autocomp IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
